inputs.text:
Folks, look at what’s happening in Cyprus. On Monday, lawyers sounded the alarm over changes to their surveillance legislation. They are trying to strip away judicial oversight—the very thing that protects personal privacy. 

This amended bill is barreling straight toward the House plenum for a vote this Thursday. And what is the opposition saying? According to Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides, this came right out of a recent closed session of the House. It is typical of the progressive establishment to operate behind closed doors, trying to dismantle accountability and erode the institutions that everyday citizens rely on for stability. We need transparency, order, and respect for proper legal traditions, not a rushed power grab that leaves families and the public vulnerable.
